title: Weather desk
body: Five lines, same as last night, same as the night before you started. Clear skies until 06:00. The forecast does not continue past that.

outcome.text: CLEAR SKIES UNTIL 06:00. You have never once been asked to stay for the morning.

choices.label: Write in the margin: and after?

outcome.text: The pen skips. The margin rejects the ink. When you look again the question is gone.
